title: Awards & recognition
intro: Verifiable wins only. No invented trophies.
archiveLead: Verifiable wins from hackathons, competitions, and community — no invented trophies.

items.title: Hackathon Winner (2nd place) — Cursor × Tec Guatemala
items.blurb: Top 2 of ~10 teams in a 4-hour sprint with El Telescopio Digital, a browser-based AR sky telescope.
body: Ranked in the top 2 of roughly 10 teams at Cursor Hackathon Guatemala, a 4-hour build sprint, for El Telescopio Digital — a browser-based AR experience that turns a phone into a live sky telescope.

In a single afternoon, shipped a production web demo that tracks the ISS and Hubble in real time using SGP4 orbital propagation and NASA/NORAD TLE data, driven by camera, gyroscope, and GPS, entirely client-side, no backend.
Proof of how fast a sharp idea can go from concept to interactive product under extreme time constraints.

items.title: Travel Grant — Cursor Buildathon San Salvador
items.blurb: Travel grant to attend the Cursor Buildathon in San Salvador and represent the local developer community.
body: Awarded a travel grant by the502project to attend the Cursor Buildathon in San Salvador, an intensive AI-first hackathon.
Selected to represent the local developer community and gained hands-on experience building with AI-assisted development tools under time pressure.

items.title: Hackathon SemiFinalist — INNOVATECH 2026
items.blurb: Co-developed Q-pay (with Qubity): P2P lending and financial management; 100+ waitlist in under a week.
body: Co-developed Q-pay with Qubity — a P2P lending and financial management platform.

Built during a high-pressure sprint, the solution integrates transparent risk assessment and debt management tools. To validate the concept, we launched a campaign and gathered a waitlist of 100+ users in less than a week, proving both technical viability and strong market demand for decentralized Fintech solutions.

items.title: Hackathon Winner (1st Place) — UFM Computer Science Hackathon
items.blurb: 1st place with Aprendi (Qubity): adaptive learning platform with intelligent user workflows.
body: Designed and built Aprendi with Qubity — an adaptive learning platform utilizing intelligent user workflows — securing 1st place in the competition.

Developed during an intensive sprint, the platform delivers personalized educational paths by dynamically adjusting content based on real-time user performance. This recognition validates technical execution, system architecture, and the scalability of AI-driven solutions in EdTech.
